one_liner: Damian Lillard connects on 92.1 percent of his free throws while averaging 24.8 points and 7.1 assists per 36 minutes.
three_things: The 92.1 percent free-throw mark is among the best in this pack of stars.
He blends scoring and playmaking at 24.8 points and 7.1 assists per 36 minutes.
Overall field-goal percentage sits at 43.5, consistent with a deep-range, high-volume shot diet.
context_note: Numbers are per-36-minute rates over a 2-season sample (seasons_played: 2), not per-game and not a full career; the manifest is descriptive_only, with no adjustment for opponent, teammates, role, or shot difficulty and a career_min_minutes>=800 inclusion floor. The two-season window is a smaller sample than most.
